name: ver02-g1r-native-lethal
description: S6 VER-02 G1-R correction (review of PR #212): five selected lethal-terminal damage owners qualified under native life-update timing, on the accepted C3a product. Contract: the synchronous maintain/rider may finish while native life state is pending; once the engine establishes death the exact relationship cleans up through the normal native/product lifecycle within 10 frames / 1.0 s of native Dead, with no later damaging round, no recreated hold, no loss of unrelated ownership and no stuck holder; rider work between the threshold crossing and native death is captured as retained behavior. A Snake weapon-lethal; B Snake constrict-lethal after surviving the weapon damage; C Salamander constrict-lethal likewise; D Crocodile later-round death roll; E Barbed Devil later-round Impale. Targets: disposable native hostile NPCs with their own faction and death policy (no Ferocity, regeneration, dying allowance, immortality or Cheat Death, verified per unit); ordinary RTWP combat. Disclosed: target HP base 100000 then Damage = HP - margin before the decisive round (1 for A/D/E; establishing weapon maximum + 1 for B/C), target escape stats -100, no XP on death, brains off (main character and pre-existing living area NPCs: IsBrainActive only, restored at teardown), holder BAB 100, summon deadlines 600 s, placement within 10.5 m, two same-owner controls per case.
